Knowledge, with sources.

OpenVibe.Wiki is the knowledge space of the OpenVibe network: wiki spaces you can build and edit together, source-backed and AI-assisted, with page trees, citations, media and discussion.

What OpenVibe.Wiki will be

Same account, same themes, same navbar as every other OpenVibe site — built in the open, run by its community.

SpacesA wiki space per topic, game, community or project.
Source-backedEvery generated page carries its sources; every edit is yours.
Page trees & historyOrganise, revise, roll back.
DiscussionTalk pages through OpenVibe.Community.
